dialogues.jp: 「ほへ〜」
dialogues.en: "Whew!"
dialogues.text: "Whew!"

dialogues.jp:
我ながらぬぼ〜っ、と崩れた表情のまま玄関の
前に立つ。
dialogues.en: Stunned, I stand in front of the entrance to my house.
dialogues.text: Stunned, I stand in front of the entrance to my house.

dialogues.jp:
扉に手をかけると、音夢がいつものように先に
帰宅しているのだろう。鍵が開いている。
dialogues.en:
I found the door was unlocked when I placed my hand on the
doorknob. Probably Nemu is already at home as usual.
dialogues.text:
I found the door was unlocked when I placed my hand on the
doorknob. Probably Nemu is already at home as usual.

dialogues.jp:
「と言うか、あいつの帰宅のスピードだけは分
　からん……」
dialogues.en: "Actually, I can't tell how fast she walks home."
dialogues.text: "Actually, I can't tell how fast she walks home."

dialogues.jp:
同じ教室をスタート地点にして、真っ直ぐ帰っ
てきている俺が追いつけないとはなんなのだろ
う……。
dialogues.en:
We leave the classroom at the same time, but I don't know
why I don't get home earlier than her. Even if I go straight
home without wasting my time on the road.
dialogues.text:
We leave the classroom at the same time, but I don't know
why I don't get home earlier than her. Even if I go straight
home without wasting my time on the road.

dialogues.jp: 「どこでもド――」
dialogues.en: "Where..."
dialogues.text: "Where..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あにゃ、お兄ちゃん発見！」
dialogues.en: "Here you are, oniichan!"
dialogues.text: "Here you are, oniichan!"

dialogues.jp:
音夢の部屋の押入れに猫型ロボットがいるのを
想像したところで、横槍が飛び込んでくる。
dialogues.en:
Peering into Nemu's closet, I was thinking about a
cat-shaped robot when I got a sudden kick.
dialogues.text:
Peering into Nemu's closet, I was thinking about a
cat-shaped robot when I got a sudden kick.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「たりゃ！」
dialogues.en: "Fwap!"
dialogues.text: "Fwap!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Gwah!"
dialogues.text: "Gwah!"

dialogues.jp: 文字通り槍のように横腹に突き刺さった。
dialogues.en: I feel a jab on my side.
dialogues.text: I feel a jab on my side.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「こんなところで出会うなんて運命！？」
dialogues.en: "What a coincidence to see you here!"
dialogues.text: "What a coincidence to see you here!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……家が隣だ」
dialogues.en: "Your house is next door."
dialogues.text: "Your house is next door."

dialogues.jp: ぐぐっ、とさくらの額を押しながら咳き込む。
dialogues.en: Pressing Sakura's forehead, I keep coughing.
dialogues.text: Pressing Sakura's forehead, I keep coughing.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「うにょ〜、お兄ちゃん、こんなイー天気なの
　に家に引きこもっちゃうの？」
dialogues.en:
"Hm, the weather is too nice to withdraw from the world,
oniichan."
dialogues.text:
"Hm, the weather is too nice to withdraw from the world,
oniichan."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「俺はひきこもりじゃない……」
dialogues.en: "I'm not withdrawing from the world."
dialogues.text: "I'm not withdrawing from the world."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、なに？」
dialogues.en: "Then, what is it?"
dialogues.text: "Then, what is it?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「面倒くさがり」
dialogues.en: "It's too much hassle for me."
dialogues.text: "It's too much hassle for me."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「はいはい……暇ならちょーどいいから。ボク
　のうちでお茶しよ〜♪」
dialogues.en:
"Fine, fine, you don't have anything to do, anyway. Let's
have tea at my house."
dialogues.text:
"Fine, fine, you don't have anything to do, anyway. Let's
have tea at my house."

dialogues.jp: ずるずる、とさくらに引きずられる。
dialogues.en: I accidentally fall for Sakura's idea.
dialogues.text: I accidentally fall for Sakura's idea.

dialogues.en: "Waah..."
dialogues.text: "Waah..."

dialogues.jp: ベッドと和菓子とマンガが遠ざかっていく……。
dialogues.en: I can see my bed, snack and manga receding...
dialogues.text: I can see my bed, snack and manga receding...

dialogues.jp:
まったく、どこから出てくる怪力か知らないが
足が地面をこすりつつさくらの家に向かった。
dialogues.en:
From somewhere I find the enormous strength to drag myself
to Sakura's house.
dialogues.text:
From somewhere I find the enormous strength to drag myself
to Sakura's house.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「まぁ、好きなところに座って」
dialogues.en: "Please sit down anywhere you want."
dialogues.text: "Please sit down anywhere you want."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「どこでも空きまくりだがな」
dialogues.en: "They're all empty anyway."
dialogues.text: "They're all empty anyway."

dialogues.jp: 本当に適当に寝転ぶ。畳の匂いが心地よい。
dialogues.en: I lie down randomly. I like the smell of tatami mats.
dialogues.text: I lie down randomly. I like the smell of tatami mats.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「にゃはははは。なんか、仲良し老夫婦みたい
　だね♪」
dialogues.en: "Nyahahahaha. We're like a happy old couple, aren't we?"
dialogues.text: "Nyahahahaha. We're like a happy old couple, aren't we?"

dialogues.jp: さくらは日当たりのよい縁側に腰掛けて微笑む。
dialogues.en: Sakura smiles, sitting on the sun-drenched veranda.
dialogues.text: Sakura smiles, sitting on the sun-drenched veranda.

dialogues.jp: 「やめぃ」
dialogues.en: "Stop that."
dialogues.text: "Stop that."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「じぃさんや……桜がきれいだよ」
dialogues.en: "Hey jiisan, aren't the cherry blossoms beautiful?"
dialogues.text: "Hey jiisan, aren't the cherry blossoms beautiful?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うぅぅ……」
dialogues.en: "Ooohhh..."
dialogues.text: "Ooohhh..."

dialogues.jp:
さくらは冗談で言っているのだろうが、なんだ
か自分が本当に年寄りじみている気がする。
dialogues.en:
I know Sakura's joking, but I feel I'm a real old man
somehow.
dialogues.text:
I know Sakura's joking, but I feel I'm a real old man
somehow.

dialogues.jp: 「分かったよ。話し相手になるって」
dialogues.en: "Okay, you can keep me company now."
dialogues.text: "Okay, you can keep me company now."

dialogues.jp: 畳をはいずってさくらの隣に座る。
dialogues.en:
I crawl up to the tatami mat that Sakura's sitting on, and
sit next to her.
dialogues.text:
I crawl up to the tatami mat that Sakura's sitting on, and
sit next to her.

dialogues.jp: 「……縁側はぬくいな」
dialogues.en: "It's warm on the veranda, isn't it?"
dialogues.text: "It's warm on the veranda, isn't it?"

dialogues.jp: 宇宙の真理が口からこぼれる。
dialogues.en: It's true.
dialogues.text: It's true.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「春だねぇ」
dialogues.en: "It's spring."
dialogues.text: "It's spring."

dialogues.jp:
さくらが危うい細さをもつ足をぶらつかせて、
春風のように笑う。
dialogues.en: Sakura smiles, as the spring breeze moves her slender legs.
dialogues.text: Sakura smiles, as the spring breeze moves her slender legs.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「春だよぉ。春ですなぁ」
dialogues.en: "Spring is here. It's spring time."
dialogues.text: "Spring is here. It's spring time."

dialogues.jp:
漢字の活用に興味でもあるのか、先ほどから同
じ言葉をくりかえしていた。
dialogues.en:
She must have an interest in Chinese characters; she's been
using the same words one after another.
dialogues.text:
She must have an interest in Chinese characters; she's been
using the same words one after another.

dialogues.jp: ひよよよよ――と、どこかで鳥が鳴いている。
dialogues.en: I hear the birds chirping somewhere.
dialogues.text: I hear the birds chirping somewhere.

dialogues.jp:
車の音、風の音、雲がゆっくりと動いている感
触。
dialogues.en: I feel the sound of cars, wind and the movement of clouds.
dialogues.text: I feel the sound of cars, wind and the movement of clouds.

dialogues.jp: そんなモノを認識してしまうほど――暇だ。
dialogues.en: I am such an idler that I can recognize those little things.
dialogues.text: I am such an idler that I can recognize those little things.

dialogues.jp: 「……別に話題もない……ん？」
dialogues.en: "Plus, nothing to talk about."
dialogues.text: "Plus, nothing to talk about."

dialogues.jp: と、さくらが俺の肩に抱きついてくる。
dialogues.en: Suddenly, Sakura's standing over my shoulders.
dialogues.text: Suddenly, Sakura's standing over my shoulders.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あったかいなぁ……こうやってるだけでボク
　は幸せだよ」
dialogues.en: "So warm...... I feel so happy by just doing this."
dialogues.text: "So warm...... I feel so happy by just doing this."

dialogues.jp: 無垢な笑顔が間近でほころぶ。
dialogues.en: I see her innocent smile right next to me.
dialogues.text: I see her innocent smile right next to me.

dialogues.jp: 「……安上がりなヤツ」
dialogues.en: "She's easy on the purse."
dialogues.text: "She's easy on the purse."

dialogues.jp:
なんだか照れくさくって、ぶっきらぼうに顔の
向きを変える。
dialogues.en: I turn my face away, feeling embarrassed.
dialogues.text: I turn my face away, feeling embarrassed.

dialogues.jp: ざざざざ――。
dialogues.en: Shoom......
dialogues.text: Shoom......

dialogues.jp: 風が、俺の部屋へと続く桜の枝を揺らした。
dialogues.en:
The cherry branches next to my room's window sway in the
wind.
dialogues.text:
The cherry branches next to my room's window sway in the
wind.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「平和だねぇ」
dialogues.en: "It's so peaceful, isn't it?"
dialogues.text: "It's so peaceful, isn't it?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「まぁな」
dialogues.en: "It's like harakiri time."
dialogues.text: "It's like harakiri time."

dialogues.jp:
小さくため息をつきつつ、名前の通り桜のいい
匂いのする少女を軽く抱きしめる。
dialogues.en: "That's too much."
dialogues.text: "That's too much."

dialogues.jp: うららかな春の日の午後。
dialogues.en:
Breathing a sigh, I give a hug to the girl that smells like
her name, cherry blossom.
dialogues.text:
Breathing a sigh, I give a hug to the girl that smells like
her name, cherry blossom.

dialogues.jp: 俺達は日向ぼっこを楽しんだ。
dialogues.en: It's a glorious spring afternoon.
dialogues.text: It's a glorious spring afternoon.

dialogues.jp: ◆日向ぼっことハラキリ◆
dialogues.en: ◆Sunbathing and Harakiri◆
dialogues.text: ◆Sunbathing and Harakiri◆

dialogues.jp:
家に入る直前にさくらに捕まり、なぜか隣の家
で日向ぼっこすることになる。
dialogues.en:
Just before I got into my house, Sakura got me, and we ended
up relaxing in the sun next door.
dialogues.text:
Just before I got into my house, Sakura got me, and we ended
up relaxing in the sun next door.

dialogues.jp:
縁側で茶をすすりながら、ハラキリみたい
ねぇ〜、などと穏やかに会話を交わす俺達
だった。
dialogues.en:
We enjoyed the moment together, drinking green tea on the
veranda and talking about harakiri as a joke.
dialogues.text:
We enjoyed the moment together, drinking green tea on the
veranda and talking about harakiri as a joke.
